g.text: Corpus Hub — Ingest Sequence (behavioral: polling, online/offline, leasing)
Upload never blocks on big boi. If the worker is asleep,
the job simply waits in QUEUED — Jeff sees "🛰️ waiting to connect".
Worker poll loop (big boi drives the connection)
If a worker dies mid-job, its lease_expires_at passes.
A sweep flips the job LEASED → QUEUED; next poll re-leases it.
